name: Taming the Beast
summary: In Dun Morogh, Taming the Beast sets a hunter on the first trial toward mastering companion beasts. In Kharanos, Grif Wildheart guides young trackers as they calm a Large Crag Boar with an enchanted taming rod.

sections.title: A Hunter's Companion
sections.body: Dwarven mountaineers and trackers depend on guns, traps, and their wits in the wild. Yet a hunter's calling is to make a lifelong bond with a wild beast. Outside the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, Grif Wildheart oversees this rite. He tests novices against several species native to Dun Morogh before asking them to bind any beast for good.

sections.title: The Crag Boar
sections.body: A Large Crag Boar is the first test for a young tracker. These thick-hided swine roam Dun Morogh's snowy foothills, where their bristling fur and tough flesh make them stubborn and fierce. Grif provides an enchanted Taming Rod. The hunter faces the boar's charge and tries to calm its fury until it submits to command.

faq.answer: Grif Wildheart offers the trial outside the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, where he trains dwarven hunters.

faq.q: Why do I tame a Large Crag Boar first?
faq.answer: Large Crag Boars are sturdy and stubborn, yet plentiful across Dun Morogh's snowy ridges. Taming one gives you a first chance to command an aggressive, thick-skinned beast calmly.

faq.q: Do I get to keep this boar forever?
faq.answer: No. The bond formed with the Taming Rod is temporary. You can command the boar, then return the rod and try other species.

faq.q: Where can I find Large Crag Boars?
faq.answer: Large Crag Boars roam the open snowfields and pine groves around Kharanos, as well as Dun Morogh's frozen slopes.

faq.q: What comes after taming the crag boar?
faq.answer: When you return to Grif Wildheart, the first lesson is complete and the second trial begins: taming a Snow Leopard.

faq.q: How does the Taming Rod work?
faq.answer: Hunter trainers provide an enchanted Taming Rod to help novices channel their will and calm wild instincts. No advanced magical training or lifelong experience with beast-whispering is needed.

angles.text: As a Hunter, you cross from novice marksman to beast master and begin the trials that unlock permanent animal companions.
As a Dwarf, you follow Ironforge mountaineers, who revere beasts able to endure Dun Morogh's biting cold. Beginning with the rugged crag boar reflects dwarven respect for grit and resilience.
